name: 1.23.0-beta.5
notes: Ren'Py games, Windows app: the app looks for the game's saves in Ren'Py's save folder (%APPDATA%\RenPy) by itself, after adding a game and on the game's page, and asks whether to import them. It reads the folder name the game itself uses, even from its compiled scripts. “Not now” stops it asking until new saves appear there. (Needs the new Windows app, build 8 or newer.)
Saves in the game's own folder (game/saves) are now shown when adding the game, with a switch to include them or leave them out.
Imported saves are copies, kept encrypted in the app; the originals are left untouched.
